name: Cervaro (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cervaro (a stag beneath a star on blue) within branches, with the inscription CITTÀ DI CERVARO in black arched above.
history: Municipal flag of Cervaro, a comune in Lazio; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Cervaro arms — stag beneath a star on blue, crowned, within branches
inscription CITTÀ DI CERVARO arched above the arms
